title: Mod-three Fourier coefficient
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define its coefficient to be $1/3$ when $S$ is empty and $0$ otherwise, plus the following term when $|S|$ is even (and zero when it is odd): $\frac{2}{3}(-\frac12)^n(-1)^{\lfloor(|S|\bmod 4)/2\rfloor}(\sqrt{3})^{|S|}$.
